info.name: PRISM IDE — Developer Intelligence & Learning Platform API
info.description: Complete production API suite for PRISM (Personalized Real-time Intelligent Skill Mentor). Includes Auth, Activity Intelligence, Skill Tracking, Tasks, Progressive Mentoring Dialogues, AST Evaluation, RAG Code Search, MCP Tools, Progress Analytics, and Reports.
